summary: A couple enters the other spouse's wage form and watches a bill replace the expected refund.
realLife: An Associated Press account entered in a 2019 House hearing record reported this case. Kraft described the change on the tax software screen when the couple entered the next W-2.
inGame: needs: two wage forms belong to the same return and only one has been entered.
gates: Two wage forms belong to the same return and only one has been entered.

turns.what: The couple finishes the joint estimate.
turns.pulledBy: The other form arrives before filing.
turns.writesBack: The household budget now carries a spring payment.

turns.pulledBy: The second employer has yet to send a form.
turns.writesBack: The unfinished return returns to the household calendar.
